title: eludite.solution.remove_item input
description: Remove on a solution item (brief 0081): the file leaves the folder's list; it stays on disk.

folder.description: A solution folder: its path from the solution root (/src/, /src/tests/) as eludite.solution.tree and the Workspace window name it, or its name when that is unique.

path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to the solution folder.
